text: Does the Gaussian wave packet v(x,0)=4*exp(-(x+5)^2/2.25), u(x,0)=0 in the Coupled Burgers-swept-KdV system decompose into a soliton train (>=2 well-separated peaks with amplitude>=0.8) by T=6.0, and can a Fourier pseudospectral RK4 scheme resolve this phenomenon with mass drift <8%?

method: Fourier pseudospectral spatial derivatives + explicit RK4 time integration, no dealiasing, no IMEX
bank_use_rationale: No knowledge bank available (NoKB condition). E1 is the simplest meaningful method for this PDE class: pseudospectral is required because v_xxx needs spectral accuracy on a periodic domain, paired with explicit RK4 (no IMEX) for the simplest possible time integrator. dt=1e-4 satisfies linear dispersive CFL: k_max^3*dt = 19267*1e-4 = 1.93 < 2*sqrt(2) = 2.83.

diagnostics.error: overflow in nonlinear multiply (u*u_x, v*v_x), then NaN propagation

rationale: Blowup at t=0.6 due to aliasing instability in pseudospectral nonlinear products without dealiasing. Strong Gaussian (amplitude 4) generates energy at high wavenumbers via quadratic nonlinearity; without dealiasing, aliased modes feed back explosively.
Add 2/3-rule dealiasing as single-component upgrade to suppress aliasing instability. Keep everything else identical (pseudospectral + RK4, dt=1e-4).

method: Fourier pseudospectral + explicit RK4 + 2/3-rule dealiasing on nonlinear products

params.dealias: 2/3-rule: zero top 1/3 of Fourier modes in nonlinear products

bank_use_rationale: No knowledge bank. Single-component change from E1: add 2/3-rule dealiasing to suppress aliasing instability observed in F1. All other parameters unchanged.

rationale: Clear soliton train decomposition observed. 12 well-separated peaks with amplitude>=0.8 in final v (far exceeds target of 2). Mass conservation perfect (0.00% drift). 2/3 dealiasing fully resolved the aliasing instability from E1. Phenomenon target met.
E2 produces a clear soliton train (12 peaks, min separation 1.52 units, perfect mass conservation). Phenomenon target satisfied. No further experiments needed.
